checks.gcc_macros: Checked GAP9 GCC 7.1.1. Going from -march=rv32imc to rv32imcxgap9 -mPE=8 -mFC=1 adds __gap9__, __pulp__, __pulp and _pulp, plus __riscv_flen 32, __riscv_fdiv, __riscv_fsqrt and __FP_FAST_FMAF. GCC defines __riscv__ and _riscv even for plain rv32imc. xgap8 and xgap10 give __gap8__ and __gap10__ respectively. The clang branch with rv32imc_xgap9 defines __gap9__, __pulp__, __pulp, _pulp, __riscv__ and _riscv, plus __riscv_xgap 9000000. None of __riscv_flen, __riscv_fdiv, __riscv_fsqrt or __FP_FAST_FMAF appears in SDK .c/.h files outside gvsoc (grep), so leaving them out is harmless. GCC defines no __GAP9__, and clang matches.
checks.no_upstream_change: The -dM output of build/20-F017 and build/int-20 is identical, apart from the __VERSION__/__clang_version__ hash, for rv32imc, rv32gc, rv64gc, riscv64-linux rv64gcv and rv32imc_xcvalu. With rv32imc_zfinx_xpulpv2 the only additions are __pulp__, __pulp, _pulp, __riscv__ and _riscv. rv32imc_xgap9 adds __gap9__ and __riscv_xgap on top of that.
checks.xgap_naming: These all parse and give the arch attribute rv32i2p1_m2p0_c2p0_zicsr2p0_zmmul1p0_zfinx1p0_xgap9p0_xpulpv2p0: rv32imc_xgap9, rv32imc_xgap (a bare xgap means 9), rv32imc_xgap9p0, rv32imc_xgap9_xpulpv2, rv32imc_xpulpv2_xgap9, rv32imc_xgap9_xpulpv, rv32imc_zfinx_xgap9, and rv32imcxgap9 without the underscore (which the base already accepted for xpulpv2). Explicit duplicates get no error and no double entry. Rejected: xgap8 and xgap10 (unsupported version number), xgap9_xgap9 (duplicated), and rv32imfc_xgap9 (F and zfinx are incompatible; GCC accepts it, and the note documents this). The round trip works: the canonical string passed back as -march gives the same macros, and llvm-mc with .attribute arch plus llvm-objdump without --mattr decodes p.abs and fadd.s. The llc feature is -mattr=+xgap, while +xgap9 is 'not a recognized feature'. That matches the fork convention (+xpulpv, not +xpulpv2), so it is not a defect.
checks.implied_set: GAP9 GCC keeps float in GPRs: 'a*b+a' becomes fmadd.s a0,a0,a1,a0 with -mabi=ilp32. The clang xgap9 build produces the same, so the zfinx implication is correct. GCC's xgap9 also has fp16 (float16/float16alt) and the GAP9-only instructions. Both are deferred and documented (a TODO for B90 in RISCVFeatures.td; D6 Q7 decides fp16 is implied later).
